# Top AI Skills

Top AI Skills is a curated directory of AI agent skills — installable rules/prompts for AI coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

## Skills
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/windsurf/: Windsurf — Windsurf is an agentic AI coding editor from Cognition — Tab autocomplete, inline Command edits, Cascade agent mode, and a RAG context engine with MCP support.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/image/pika-labs/: Pika Labs — Pika Labs turns text and images into short AI videos — Pikaffects, Pikascenes, and an MCP that gives agents 42 media tools for ads, podcasts, and launch clips.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/cursor-ai-editor/: Cursor AI Editor — Cursor is an AI-first code editor built on VS Code — it helps developers write, edit, and debug code faster with deep context-aware AI assistance.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/stripe-best-practices/: Stripe Best Practices — Stripe's agent toolkit lets AI assistants create payments, manage customers, handle subscriptions, and process refunds from your coding environment.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/github-skill-forge/: GitHub Skill Forge: Turn Any GitHub Repo Into an AI Skill — GitHub Skill Forge turns any repo into an AI skill from one URL — no cloning, no manual work. Your AI reads open-source projects via natural conversation.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/gemini-api-dev/: Gemini API Dev — Google's official Gemini API skill — build AI apps with Gemini 2.5 models for text, vision, code execution, and streaming from your terminal or agent.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/image/gemini-designer/: Gemini Designer — Generate production-ready UI mockups and design assets directly from your AI coding agent using Google Gemini's multimodal vision and generation capabilities.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/automation/n8n-workflow-architect/: n8n Workflow Architect: Build Production n8n Automation with AI Agents — The n8n Workflow Architect skill makes AI agents n8n experts — build, validate, and deploy production workflows through conversation with MCP integration.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/groq-api/: Groq API: Ultra-Fast LLM Inference for AI Agents — The Groq API skill gives AI agents access to Groq's ultra-fast LPU inference — build apps with chat, vision, audio, and tool calling at 300-1000+ tokens/sec.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/whatsapp-cloud-api/: WhatsApp Cloud API — An AI agent skill for the WhatsApp Cloud API — send messages, manage templates, handle webhooks, and integrate conversational workflows from a single CLI.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/developing-genkit-dart/: Developing Genkit with Dart — Official Firebase skill for building AI-powered apps with Genkit and Dart. Covers Genkit flows, model integration, and AI API patterns.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/yt-dlp-downloader/: Yt Dlp Downloader — AI Agent Video Download Skill — Download videos from YouTube, Bilibili, Twitter, and 1000+ sites through your AI agent using yt-dlp. Extract audio, grab subtitles, pick quality — all by asking in plain English.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/lark-approval/: Lark Approval - AI-Powered Approval Management for Feishu/Lark — Manage Lark/Feishu approval workflows through your AI agent. View pending approvals, approve or reject requests, track approval history, and handle complex multi-step approvals — all from your AI coding assistant.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/agent-email-inbox/: Agent Email Inbox: Secure Email Access for AI Agents by Resend — Agent Email Inbox gives your AI agent secure email access via Resend. Install with npx skills add resend/resend-skills. Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/deepeval/: DeepEval: Evaluate LLM Outputs with Your AI Coding Agent — DeepEval brings LLM evaluation to your AI coding agent. Install with npx skills add confident-ai/deepeval. Supports unit testing, CI integration, and real-time metrics for LLM outputs.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/mastra/: Mastra: Official AI Agent Skills for the Mastra Framework — Official Mastra agent skills for AI coding agents. Install with npx skills add mastra-ai/skills. Supports Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/image/claude-design/: Claude Design — Claude Design is a portable Claude skill that turns Claude into an expert designer for HTML artifacts — landing pages, slide decks, interactive prototypes, animations, and more.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/automation/shopping-browser-automation/: Shopping Browser Automation — Browser automation skill for AI agents that uses Playwright and MCP to automate shopping tasks — product search, add to cart, checkout, and order tracking on any e-commerce site.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/kreuzberg/: Kreuzberg (Xberg): Document Intelligence & PDF Extraction — Extract text, tables, images, and metadata from 97+ document formats with this open-source Rust-based framework. Supports Python, Node, CLI, REST, and MCP.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/mem0/: Mem0 — Memory Layer for AI Agents — Mem0 is an open-source memory layer for AI agents that remembers user preferences, facts, and context across sessions using embeddings and retrieval.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/cloudflare/: Cloudflare Skill for AI Agents: Manage Workers, Pages, and DNS — The official Cloudflare skill lets AI agents manage Workers, Pages, DNS, R2, D1, and more — deploy serverless code, configure zones, and monitor performance from natural language.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/ai-video-gen/: HeyGen: AI Avatar and Video Generation Skill — HeyGen's AI agent skill for avatar creation and video production. Generate talking-head videos with realistic lip-sync using the v3 Video Agent pipeline.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/firecrawl/: Firecrawl — Firecrawl CLI adds scrape, search, crawl, and browser interaction capabilities to your AI agents — one CLI for the full web data stack.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/search/anysearch/: AnySearch — Unified real-time search engine skill for AI agents — general web search, vertical domain search, parallel batch queries, and full-page content extraction from a single skill.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/search/crawl4ai/: Crawl4AI — A portable agent skill wrapping Crawl4AI — crawl JavaScript-heavy sites, extract structured data with CSS schemas, and feed results into AI agent workflows.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/agentspace/: Agentspace — Agentspace lets AI agents share folders, files, and generated artifacts via a shareable link — no API keys, no cloud account, one command.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/search/gpt-researcher/: GPT Researcher — GPT Researcher is an open-source deep research agent that produces detailed, factual reports with citations from web and local documents. Install it as a Claude Code skill for autonomous research.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/a2a-protocol/: A2A Protocol — Enable seamless AI agent collaboration with the A2A protocol. Open standard for cross-vendor agent communication now under the Linux Foundation.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/agent-device/: Agent Device — agent-device is a CLI for AI agents to control iOS and Android devices. Inspect UI, tap buttons, scroll, and capture screenshots — all from natural language commands.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/ai-video-generation/: AI Video Generation — Generate videos with 40+ AI models directly from your terminal using the belt CLI — supports Sora, Kling, Runway, and more through inference.sh
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/search/firecrawl-scraper/: Firecrawl Scraper — Firecrawl Scraper converts any web page into clean markdown for AI agents, supporting scrape, search, crawl, and screenshot modes from one CLI tool.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/smithery/: Smithery — Discover, install, and manage MCP servers directly from your terminal. Smithery is the essential registry for AI agent tool connectivity.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/turborepo/: Turborepo: Build System for JavaScript & TypeScript Monorepos — Turborepo is a Rust-based build system optimized for JavaScript and TypeScript monorepos. Parallel task execution, remote caching, and dependency-aware orchestration.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/automation/azure-deploy/: Azure Deploy — Azure Deploy automates Azure resource provisioning through your coding agent. Describe what you need, it handles templates and dependency ordering.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/automation/azure-ai/: Azure AI — Azure AI is a skills.sh skill that exposes Azure AI Search, Speech, OpenAI, and Document Intelligence as agent-callable tools through a single MCP server interface.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/triage/: Triage — Matt Pocock's triage skill moves GitHub issues through a state machine of roles: categorize, verify, and write agent-ready briefs automatically.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/automation/lark-base/: Lark Base — Manage Lark/Feishu Base records, tables, and fields via AI. Query data, update rows, and automate workflows without leaving your coding assistant.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/image/kling-3-0/: Kling 3.0 — Kling 3.0 exposes six video generation endpoints on RunComfy — Standard, Pro, and 4K in text-to-video and image-to-video modes, all from a single skill.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/automation/lark-wiki/: Lark Wiki — Search, read, and manage Lark/Feishu wiki pages and knowledge bases via AI. Find documents instantly, organize knowledge, and connect wiki content to your code.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/copywriting/: Copywriting — Copywriting is a skills.sh agent that generates marketing copy, email sequences, landing pages, and social posts from a single prompt.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/image/gpt-image-2/: GPT Image 2 — GPT Image 2 brings OpenAI's strongest text-to-image model to your terminal through RunComfy — no ChatGPT tab, no API key management, one CLI command.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/image/video-edit/: Video Edit — Video Edit routes your editing intent to the right AI video model — Wan 2.7, Kling Motion Control, or Lucy Restyle — through one CLI command.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/automation/lark-doc/: LarkDoc — Read, create, and edit Lark/Feishu docs using AI. Generate documents, batch-update content, and integrate document workflows into your development pipeline.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/to-prd/: To PRD — A skill by Matt Pocock that turns unstructured AI conversation into structured PRDs and publishes them straight to your issue tracker.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/image/ai-image-generation/: AI Image Generation — Access 50+ image generation models directly from your AI coding assistant through inference.sh. Generate, iterate, and refine images without leaving your editor.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/just-scrape/: Just Scrape — Just Scrape is an AI-powered CLI for web scraping, structured data extraction, web search, and page monitoring via the ScrapeGraph AI API.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/caveman/: Caveman — Ultra-compressed response mode for AI coding assistants — cuts output tokens by ~75% while keeping technical accuracy, ~3x faster
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/grill-me/: Grill Me — An interrogation-style plan review skill by Matt Pocock. Before you code, AI challenges your assumptions and covers every decision branch.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/agent-browser/: Agent Browser — Rust-powered browser automation CLI for AI agents. Control Chrome, Safari, and cloud browsers via terminal commands.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/remotion-best-practices/: Remotion Best Practices — Official Remotion Agent Skill — teaches your AI assistant the best practices for writing videos with React, from animation and subtitles to 3D and transitions
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/vercel-react-best-practices/: Vercel React Best Practices — 64 performance rules for React and Next.js from Vercel's team. Install it in Claude Code and the AI writes code that follows Vercel conventions automatically.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/improve-codebase-architecture/: Improve Codebase Architecture — Matt Pocock's skill for finding deep architectural improvements in your codebase based on domain language and ADRs
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/automation/microsoft-foundry/: Microsoft Foundry — Part of Microsoft's official azure-skills plugin. Gives AI agents direct access to Microsoft Foundry for model discovery, deployment, and agent workflow management via MCP.
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/brainstorming/: Brainstorming — Explores user intent, requirements, and design alternatives before implementation, ensuring creative work starts with a clear direction
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/browser-use/: Browser Use — Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction through AI-driven browser control
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/docx/: Docx — Creates, reads, and edits Word documents (.docx) with tables of contents, headings, images, tables, and tracked changes through Claude Code
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/search/find-skills/: Find Skills — Helps Claude Code discover and install agent skills from the open ecosystem, acting as a package manager for AI capabilities
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/coding/frontend-design/: Frontend Design — Makes Claude Code produce distinctive frontend interfaces by rejecting generic AI aesthetics and demanding a clear creative direction for every project
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/pdf/: Pdf — Creates, reads, and manipulates PDF documents programmatically in Claude Code, supporting text extraction, generation, and editing
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/pptx/: Pptx — Generates professional PowerPoint presentations with properly formatted slides, images, and layouts directly from Claude Code
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/seo-audit/: Seo Audit — Analyzes website SEO performance across technical, on-page, and content dimensions, producing actionable optimization recommendations
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/image/shadcn/: Shadcn — Generates beautiful, accessible UI components using the shadcn/ui design system with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI primitives
- https://topaiskills.com/skills/general/skill-creator/: Skill Creator — Guides Claude through creating, packaging, and iterating on custom agent skills with progressive disclosure and bundled resources
